source_snapshot.criteria: Train to expected width and speed with no Errors
source_snapshot.script: No bundle; 30 attended and 180 machine minutes; unique row/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; assumes NVIDIA LTSSM/NVQual and operator setup can perform the Gen1-to-Gen6 loop.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/HIGH; held Pending for positive Gen6 capability, Speed Change 16, 500 transactions and recovery.

old_problem: Exposing a Gen6 selector does not prove that every path element and firmware supports Gen6. Forcing unsupported operation can downtrain, loop in Recovery or strand the endpoint, while a final snapshot cannot prove 500 Gen1-origin transitions.
disposition_reason: The review method and source oracle are complete. Gen6 feasibility is a mandatory runtime prerequisite: execute only when authoritative project evidence certifies the whole path at required width; otherwise mark execution BLOCKED/N/A only under approved SPEC, without changing the testcase or retaining a review decision.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2112, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2113 / Wistron-GB NV PVP HW-00034-V003 / c65aae957655bb38 was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
The source explicitly requires 500 Gen1-to-Gen6 changes at expected width/speed with no errors; Gen5 or reduced-width results cannot substitute.
Before binding Speed Change 16, require affirmative Gen6/full-width support for root port, switch, retimer, board/backplane, endpoint/GPU, firmware and tool; software exposure alone is insufficient.
For each cycle prove Gen1/full-width start, then capture Gen6 request, equalization/LTSSM, settle deadline, final width/speed, enumeration and fresh error/health deltas.
If support is absent, execution is BLOCKED; only an authoritative project SPEC may declare N/A. Never force registers or silently downgrade.

Count only 500 complete chronological transactions and stop before the next request on unsupported mode, wrong start, failed/late/downtrained target, device loss, new disqualifying error/reset or evidence gap.
Preserve first-fault evidence, do not clear or automatically retry, and use signed out-of-band recovery.
No capability probe, LTSSM/NVQual, speed forcing/change, PCIe query, recovery, retry or DUT operation was performed.

test_case.purpose: Qualify five hundred genuine full-width Gen1-to-Gen6 transitions on the mapped path, but only after authoritative end-to-end Gen6 capability is proven.
required_package: Authoritative Gen6/full-width capability evidence for every path component, firmware and qualification tool
Pinned NVIDIA LTSSM/NVQual Speed Change 16 build, command and configuration
Approved Gen1 entry, Gen6 equalization/LTSSM/settle/error and exact 500-count rules
Dedicated SUT, durable ledger/interlock, stable power/cooling, console and recovery
test_case.test_command: DO NOT FORCE OR EXECUTE until Project Configuration positively certifies end-to-end Gen6/full-width support and binds Speed Change 16. After point approval preserve baselines and execute entries 1..500, proving Gen1/full width before each request and recording Gen6 request, equalization/LTSSM, settled speed/width, enumeration, error deltas and health before the next entry. Stop on first unsupported state, fault or gap; do not clear, downgrade or retry.
test_case.expected_result: With capability proven, all 500 entries independently show full-width Gen1 start and Gen6 settle within the signed envelope, required devices present, no disqualifying new PCIe/GPU/host/BMC/thermal/power error and approved final health. Without capability, execution remains BLOCKED.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until positive Gen6 capability, tool/path/start method and limits are approved. PASS then requires 500 complete accepted Gen1-to-Gen6 records. FAIL on force/mismatch, invalid start, failed/late/downtrained/reduced target, device loss, disqualifying error/reset or failed recovery. Missing capability/input/artifact is BLOCKED; N/A needs authoritative SPEC.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED without positive Gen6/full-width proof for the complete physical/firmware path.
Never force an exposed speed value or substitute Gen5/reduced width.
Use only the approved primitive on an isolated SUT with console, stable power/cooling and point authorization.
Preserve first-fault evidence and stop without automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash and positive component-by-component Gen6 capability matrix
Pinned Speed Change 16 tool/configuration and complete topology/lane/firmware map
Gen1-start plus Gen6 equalization/full-width/deadline/error contract and pre-test baseline
Ledger 1..500 with raw start, request, LTSSM/equalization, settled Gen6/width, enumeration, timestamps and result
Per-cycle AER/kernel/GPU/BMC/thermal/power correlation and completeness audit
First-fault/recovery or clean final state, no-force/no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On unsupported indication, invalid Gen1 entry, failed/late/downtrained Gen6, device loss, disqualifying error/reset or artifact gap, inhibit all later requests and preserve the first event. Do not force, downgrade or retry; follow signed recovery and quarantine if expected topology/health is not restored.

source_conflict.reason: Source and reviews agree on Gen1-to-Gen6; feasibility is an explicit project capability prerequisite, not contradictory scope.

blocked.reason: Static review is complete. Runtime execution becomes BLOCKED if affirmative Gen6 support is absent; that conditional state does not require a further review decision.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Positive full-path Gen6 capability matrix, Speed Change 16 recipe, per-cycle Gen1 start, Gen6 equalization/width/settle/error rules, 500-ledger/interlock and recovery.
pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED; POSITIVE GEN6 CAPABILITY GATE CLOSED; NO CAPABILITY PROBE, LTSSM/NVQUAL, SPEED FORCE/CHANGE, PCIE QUERY, RECOVERY, RETRY OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED
pending.owner: GB-NV-PVP PCIe/NVIDIA qualification and platform owners
pending.unlock_condition: Bind authoritative Gen6 capability and all project inputs, then receive point authorization; absent capability, keep execution BLOCKED or use N/A only with SPEC.

external_authorities.application: Allows parameterized review while requiring positive support before N/A or high-risk execution and forbidding unsupported forcing, downgrade and retry.

project_authority: Platform/PCIe owner certifies full-path Gen6; NVIDIA owner supplies Speed Change 16; platform owner approves recovery; engineer owns final verdict.
